about.title: About PT. Suryatama Indonesia
about.subtitle: Building the future of integrated logistics and services with passion and sincerity since 2006.
about.profileP1: PT. Suryatama Indonesia was established on May 23, 2006, operating in Transportation & Outsourcing Service.
about.profileP2: Starting with industrial transportation services, we have continually grown into an indispensable "key partner" for leading manufacturing corporations.
about.leadershipDesc: Guiding PT. Suryatama Indonesia towards operational excellence, robust business compliance, and fostering a safety-first culture across all operational lines.
about.sloganText: Build the future with passion and sincerity
about.sloganSub: Building a better future through unwavering passion and heartfelt sincerity.
about.visionText: To be a "key partner" in integrated logistics and service in Indonesia
about.visionSub: Becoming a key partner in integrated logistics and service in Indonesia.
about.mission1Desc: Safety is the doorway to everything. Safety is the primary threshold ensuring the success of every working activity.
about.mission2Desc: Maintain quality for customer satisfaction with continuous consistency across all service levels.
about.mission3Desc: Developing teamwork that is collaborative, disciplined, and mutually supportive.
about.mission4Desc: Implementing IT in all lines to enhance operational visibility, tracking, and process efficiency.
about.mission5Desc: Implementing business compliance across all business and regulatory obligations.
about.mission6Desc: Maintain environmental sustainability in our everyday transport and outsourcing operations.

services.title: Our Services
services.subtitle: A reliable blend of industrial logistics transportation and certified outsourcing support services.
services.transportSubtitle: Developing transportation businesses since 2006. Customer trust remains the cornerstone of our continuous growth.
services.transportIntro: To cater to specific manufacturing demands, we deliver diverse delivery arrangements utilizing self-owned and associate truck fleets:
services.milkRunDesc: Scheduled multi-supplier pickup routes to the customer factory in an integrated loop for optimal time management and load capacity.
services.milkRunClients: Clients served: Asahimas, Vuteq, Hyundai Glovis, Hyundai Livart.
services.directDesc: Direct point-to-point transit services safely, punctually, and according to strict delivery schedules.
services.onSiteDesc: Internal cargo haulage and inventory repositioning within the customer's manufacturing plant premises.
services.outsourcingSubtitle: Trained and professional workforce solutions to empower business operational efficiency.
services.securityDesc: The vast majority of our security personnel are certified by the SECOM security training center, trained in rigorous protocols and vigilant safety procedures.
services.securityStandardsDesc: Our security personnel are trained in manufacturing safety protocols, strict vehicle gate inspections, and round-the-clock site surveillance.
services.cleaningDesc: Comprehensive industrial cleaning for factories, warehouses, and offices following hygienic and environmental safety standards.
services.driverDesc: Executive driver services for expatriates featuring defensive driving certifications, courteous etiquette, and thorough route navigation knowledge.

fleet.title: Our Truck Fleet
fleet.subtitle: A robust, meticulously inspected fleet to ensure uninterrupted supply chain operations.
fleet.growthSubheading: Year-by-year fleet volume development (combining self-owned and associate trucks).
fleet.standardDesc: Available in Wing Box Truck configurations with 7.5 m and 9.5 m box lengths, alongside small, medium, and heavy trucks adhering to Department of Transportation standards.
fleet.customDesc: Engineered according to specialized customer needs balancing safety requirements and cost efficiency. Featuring Automatic Conveyor systems installed in the engine area and seating cargo compartments.
fleet.assetSubheading: Data update October 31, 2025: Total 20 self-owned truck units.

operations.title: Operations & Safety
operations.subtitle: Safety First is the doorway to everything in our daily operations.
operations.exerciseDesc: Morning physical stretching routine conducted together with all personnel before commencing work to maintain prime fitness.
operations.healthDesc: Detailed health and vital condition checks for every driver before vehicle dispatch.
operations.briefingDesc: Daily safety talks and operational briefing updates to ensure all team members strictly adhere to work instructions.
operations.gpsDesc: All truck routes are actively monitored and managed through a centralized GPS system to guarantee delivery punctuality and fleet security.
operations.trainingSubheading: Continuous development for new personnel and refreshment programs for experienced staff.
operations.driverTrainingDesc: Smart Driving and Safety Driving programs to reinforce defensive driving techniques and highway safety compliance.
operations.forkliftTrainingDesc: Safety Operation certification for material handling equipment to prevent warehouse incident risks.
operations.maintenance24Desc: Secure pool premises with round-the-clock monitoring and vehicle parking 24 hours a day, 7 days a week.
operations.maintenanceTypesDesc: Rigorous execution of Preventive Maintenance, Breakdown Maintenance, and Scheduled Maintenance.
operations.maintenancePartnersDesc: Close collaboration with 2 trusted associate partner companies for auxiliary storing and overflow vehicle staging.

clients.intro: The confidence placed in us by reputable industrial partners reflects our steadfast commitment to safe, punctual, and high-quality logistics execution.
clients.partnershipNote: We are dedicated to continuously elevating our operational standards to foster resilient, enduring business partnerships.
